turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Kind of tired, honestly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My home desk is buried under papers. Bills, receipts, letters from school.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Two ways to go. Scan everything and go mostly paperless, or set up a small filing box with folders?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My grandson set up Moshi so I could hear audiobooks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One second, Moshi. Flatmate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is your brother still coming over?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: He said around eight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, go ahead and take the last slice.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Are you sure? Thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How was the trail you did last week?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Beautiful, but really muddy near the waterfall.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Would it be okay for the kids?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The first part, yes. The last mile is steep with loose rocks, I wouldn't bring them up there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could just go to the waterfall and turn back.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's the best bit anyway. They'll love it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, Moshi, I'm all done over here. Your turn.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, the pile of bills and letters. Which system?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. My tomato seedlings are tall and spindly and falling over. Did I do something wrong?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's called legginess, and it's really common. They're stretching towards the light because they aren't getting enough.
